messages:
Maya: Customer RFP asks for a 90-day pinned model for 'translate-edge-v1' with perf SLAs and a documented migration path. Can we outline product options and risks?
Sam: Three quick options: (1) Soft-pin (30d) included; (2) Paid Reserved Pool (90d pin + SLA); (3) Require Dedicated for strict guarantees.
Ibrahim: Risk: reserved pools fragment packing; if >3 customers do this simultaneously, it kills efficiency. Need min-commit + surcharge.
Nina: Bench ask from customer: p95 < 320ms @512 tokens, embedding similarity >=0.95, and regression veto if >1.5% drop on key prompts.
ops-bot: Bench gate proposal: score = 0.5*latency_norm + 0.35*quality_norm + 0.15*stability_norm. GA if score >= 0.8 and no veto triggers.
Maya: Product proposal: ship Paid-pin as add-on with Reserved Pool tag; SLA: p95 <=350ms, 99.95% uptime, 10 business days migration notice, 3-day rollback window. Soft-pin remains 30d.
Sam: Launch gates: bench suite pass, infra cost delta approved, legal retention addendum, 2 canaries (1 customer + 1 internal) OR 3 customer canaries.
Ibrahim: Actions: Eng -> cost delta + capacity reservation plan (3bd). Product -> pricing + renewal flow (EOW). CS -> collect sample prompts & traffic distro.
Nina: I'll upload test prompts to /mnt/onboard/pin-examples and include a canary config example.
ops-bot: Canary config snippet:
```
canary:
  mode: reserved
  duration_days: 14
  traffic_pct: 5
```
Maya: Note: include auto-unpin at term unless renewed, and a customer opt-in renewal workflow. Quick sync after infra numbers are in.
